jobs.title: Project Coordinator III
jobs.description:
Job Title

Project Coordinator III

Agency

Texas A&M University Health Science Center

Department

Center for Community Health & Aging

Proposed Minimum Salary

Commensurate

Job Location

College Station, Texas

Job Type

Staff

Job Description

Our Commitment

Texas A&M University is committed to enriching the learning and working environment by promoting a culture that respects all perspectives, talents & lived experiences. Embracing varying opinions and perspectives strengthens our core values which are: Respect, Excellence, Leadership, Loyalty, Integrity, and Selfless Service.   

Who We Are

As one of the fastest-growing academic health centers in the nation, Texas A&M Health encompasses five colleges and numerous centers and institutes working together to improve health through transformative education, innovative research and team-based health care delivery.

What We Want

The Project Coordinator III
supports the day-to-day operations of the Special Events, Services, and Resources core within the Texas Opioid Prevention for Students (TOPS) initiative. TOPS is a statewide, multitiered system of support (MTSS) funded by the Opioid Abatement Fund Council to prevent opioid misuse and overdose among K–12 students across Texas. Under general supervision of the Project Director, the Project Coordinator III supports the Project Manager III and the TOPS project team by coordinating and assisting with the completion of core project activities, including community implementation and outreach events, behavioral health service linkage and referral navigation support, and connecting students and families to opioid prevention resources and overdose education. This position benefits from familiarity with behavioral health systems and referral pathways but does not require clinical licensure.

What You Need To Know

Salary:
Will be commensurate based on the selected hire’s education and experience.

Please note:
This position is grant funded; future employment may be contingent upon future funding.

Apply! 
Submitting a cover letter, CV/Resume to assist us with the review process. You may upload these documents on the application under CV/Resume.  

Responsibilities

Project Coordination and Management

Coordinates core project activities supporting special events, community outreach, and resource linkage initiatives, including presentations, awareness campaigns, and community implementation events and initiatives.
Assists in developing and assessing work plans, schedules, and project controls to ensure core activities align with grant deliverables, timelines, and organizational objectives.
Prepares forecasting and progress reports against milestones, budgetary updates, and the change management process for core activities.
Monitors and prepares reports on financial activity and resource utilization for the assigned core project budget.
Coordinates with the Project Manager III, TOPS project team, and partner organizations to ensure cross-project dependencies and impacts are identified and managed.

Resource and Referral Service Support

Assists in coordinating behavioral health service connections, including scheduling and logistics for warm handoffs, telehealth navigation, and referral pathway documentation for students and families.
Supports student and family access to opioid prevention resources and overdose education programming by helping connect individuals to appropriate community based services; coordinates with vendors, community partners, and healthcare providers in the delivery and support of resources and services for core activities.
Maintains database integrity, security, and accuracy of program and participant data in compliance with applicable privacy and data governance requirements.

Policy and Compliance Oversight

Helps ensure core activities comply with university and system policies, rules, and procedures, as well as grant requirements and funder expectations.
Interprets program guidelines, procedures, policies, rules, and regulations and helps ensure they are followed.
Supports adherence to evidence-informed prevention models, harm reduction approaches, and trauma-informed care frameworks across core activities.

Reporting and Documentation

Does not supervise staff or students; assists with onboarding documentation for new team members and community collaborators.
Prepares training and operational materials supporting core activities, including materials used in workshops, technical assistance sessions, and onboarding for community collaborators.
Writes reports, meeting summaries, and other related materials documenting core activities, service linkages, referral outcomes, and training records; assists in preparing conference abstracts, presentations, and dissemination materials.

Required Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in applicable field or equivalent combination of education or experience.
Five years of related experience in project coordination/administration.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in behavioral health, substance use prevention, public health, or community outreach settings.
Familiarity with evidence-informed prevention models, harm reduction approaches, and trauma-informed care frameworks.
Experience coordinating community health events, outreach campaigns, health fairs, or training programs.
Knowledge of school-based or youth-centered health services, including telehealth platforms and referral protocols.
Familiarity with naloxone access, overdose education, and related opioid prevention initiatives.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Ability to multitask and work cooperatively with others.
Knowledge of word processing and spreadsheet applications; familiarity with MS Office applications including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook, and comfort with virtual meeting platforms and data tools such as Qualtrics and Monday.com.
Knowledge of standard proofreading.
Ability to prioritize, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines.
Working familiarity with behavioral health terminology and referral pathways (e.g., warm handoffs, stigma-reduction strategies) helpful in supporting core coordination tasks.
Strong oral and written communication skills with the ability to tailor messaging for differing audiences, including students, families, educators, and community partners.

Why Texas A&M University?

We are a prestigious university with strong traditions, Core Values, and a community of caring and collaboration.  Amenities associated with a major university, such as sporting and cultural events, state-of-the-art recreation facilities, the Bush Library and Museum, and much more await you.  Experience all that a big city has to offer but with a reasonable cost-of-living and no long commutes.  

Medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, life and AD&D, flexible spending accounts, and long-term disability insurance with Texas A&M contributing to employee health and basic life premiums 
12-15 days of annual paid holidays  
Up to eight hours of paid sick leave and at least eight hours of paid vacation each month 
Automatic enrollment in the Teacher Retirement System of Texas  
Health and Wellness: Free exercise programs and release time 
Professional Development: All employees have access to free LinkedIn Learning training, webinars, and limited financial support to attend conferences, workshops, and more  
Educational release time and tuition assistance for completing a degree while a Texas A&M employee 
Living Well, a program at Texas A&M that has been built by employees, for employees 

Instructions to Applicants:
Applications received by Texas A&M University must either have all job application data entered, or a resume attached. Failure to provide all job application data or a complete resume could result in an invalid submission and a rejected application. We encourage all applicants to upload a resume or use a LinkedIn profile to prepopulate the online application.

All positions are security-sensitive. Applicants are subject to a criminal history investigation, and employment is contingent upon the institution’s verification of credentials and/or other information required by the institution’s procedures, including the completion of the criminal history check.

Equal Opportunity/Veterans/Disability Employer.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Who We Are

The Office of Academic Multicultural Initiatives (OAMI) supports and celebrates students' unique experiences, backgrounds, communities, and identities. Through a variety of programs, events, and campus-wide collaborations, we provide holistic support to help students achieve their academic ambitions while developing the skills and perspectives necessary for success in college and beyond. These initiatives support U-M's ongoing commitment to nurturing an intellectually and culturally diverse campus. This is accomplished through direct student service delivery that incorporates success coaching, peer mentorship, individual and student organization advising, student leadership development, and grant funding for student organizations and initiatives to promote academic and multicultural programming.

OAMI also leads key university-wide multicultural programs, including the Annual Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. Symposium, the Native American Student Association Powwow, gateway services for first-generation and DACA/undocumented students, and the coordination of eight annual cultural graduation celebration ceremonies.

Job Summary

The SuccessConnects Program Coordinator serves as a key contributor to OAMI's SuccessConnect program by providing holistic, strengths-based support that promotes undergraduate student success, retention, and engagement. The position combines direct student success coaching with the coordination of academic support initiatives that help students successfully navigate the transition to the university and achieve their academic, personal, and professional goals.

Through individualized and group success coaching, the Program Coordinator empowers students to develop effective strategies for academic achievement, personal growth, leadership development, and career exploration while connecting them with university resources and opportunities that enhance their educational experience.

The position also coordinates the day-to-day implementation of the SuccessConnect tutoring initiative by providing coordination of the delivery of individualized academic support and a team of student tutors, monitoring the program component's operations to enhance the delivery of academic support services.

Student Success Coaching - 65%

Provide holistic coaching services to enrolled students in SuccessConnects program; provide assistance to students to ensure their academic, personal and professional success
Meet one-on-one as well as in group settings with students to provide advice and counsel on curriculum-specific themes
Analyze, compare, and evaluate various courses of action for students within the scope of responsibilities and refer students to appropriate university resources as needed
Accept and act on referrals to support student needs and conduct follow-up on the utilization of resources
Follow program evaluation protocols to assess the effectiveness and impact of services on students and the university community.
Assist in the development of curricular content and participate in workshop presentations that support the growth and achievement of participants and address interests, challenges, knowledge, and experiences related to the overall success
Coordinate opportunities to build community and a supportive network of scholars
Identify and coordinate resources, experiential learning opportunities, and resource connections to enhance student awareness and preparation for collegiate and post-baccalaureate opportunities.
Maintain student participation and engagement documentation and data files
Manage, communicate, track, and analyze elements related to student progress, involvement, and participation via CRM tools

Tutoring Initiative Coordination - 35%

Coordinate the day-to-day implementation and operation of the SuccessConnect tutoring initiative to ensure the effective delivery of individualized academic support services that complement the program's holistic student success model.
Coordinate processes related to the recruitment, hiring, onboarding, training, scheduling, and ongoing support of undergraduate student tutors.
Provide guidance and accountability for a team of student tutors, fostering professionalism, inclusive practices, effective tutoring practices, and adherence to program expectations.
Oversee tutor assignments, student matching, tutoring schedules, communications, attendance tracking, and related operational processes to support efficient delivery of tutoring services.
Review tutor timekeeping records and process payroll approvals in accordance with university procedures.
Collaborate with evaluation staff to collect, analyze, and report tutoring participation and outcome data that inform program planning and effectiveness.
Support the coordinate of participation in campus-wide tutor resource platform, and student outreach and communication efforts that promote awareness and utilization of tutoring services among students, staff, and campus partners.
Serve as the primary point of contact for tutors by providing guidance, troubleshooting operational concerns, and connecting tutors and students with appropriate campus resources when needed.

Required Qualifications*

Bachelor's degree and at least two years of experience in college student service.
Knowledge of the University of Michigan student academic and social culture.

Modes of Work

The work requirements allow both onsite and offsite work and an employee has an expected recurring onsite presence. On occasion, the employee may be required and must be available to work onsite more frequently if necessitated by unit leadership or their designee and/or the job requirements.

U-M EEO Statement

The University of Michigan is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.

jobs.description:
Current Employees: If you are currently employed at any of the Universities of Wisconsin, log in to Workday to apply through the internal application process.

Job Category:

Academic Staff

Employment Type:

Regular

Job Profile:

Student Affairs Program Specialist

Job Summary:

The Program Coordinator for Belonging Programs is an integral member of the team primarily responsible for overseeing programmatic initiatives for the Centers for Student Success and Belonging, with a focus on support of the Indigenous Student Center.

The Program Coordinator oversees the daily operations of the Indigenous Student Center facility, develops and executes programming, supervises student interns, and leads the planning and execution of campus-wide programming for Native November while supporting broader programming across the Centers for Student Success and Belonging. The Program Coordinator also convenes the Indigenous Student Center Coalition, a group of faculty, staff and student stakeholders representing a variety of campus offices. This position serves as a key resource and collaborator for campus-wide efforts toward access and inclusion.

Key Job Responsibilities:

Organizes student-focused programming and resources to promote new and ongoing educational initiatives
Support, supervise, and actively mentor student interns, fostering their personal and professional development, while cultivating a collaborative and growth-oriented team environment
Management and general stewardship over daily operations of the Indigenous Student Center, 215 N. Brooks Street, including coordinating reservations for events, office hours, drop-in services, etc.
Serves as a subject matter expert regarding student affairs to internal and external stakeholders
Generates and analyzes reports of curricular and unit outcomes
Creates and maintains schedules, logistics, and resources for one or multiple student affairs programs, activities, and/or services
Lead campus-wide signature events and programs that foster belonging by creating inclusive, high-impact experiences with students and partners, ensuring responsive, collaborative initiatives that advance student success and cultivate a vibrant, pluralistic campus culture
Writes, edits, and publishes content for various communication projects and marketing platforms to align with strategic initiatives and established communication campaigns

Department:

Student Affairs, Student Success and Belonging, Centers for Student Success and Belonging

The Centers for Student Success and Belonging are organized within the Student Success and Belonging Theme Area of Student Affairs. Student Success and Belonging creates programming and operates spaces that provide support, advocacy, and co-curricular experiences that center, affirm, and celebrate UW students. We cultivate a sense of belonging and community while strengthening all students’ capacity to learn, lead, and thrive. Within the Centers of Student Success and Belonging is the Multicultural Student Center, which is home to four cultural centers. This includes the Indigenous Student Center, which houses the portfolio's visibility and representation work focused on Native American and American Indian Tribal sovereignty, advancing access and inclusion, and development of programs and resources to foster awareness of Indigenous cultures and perspectives at UW-Madison.

Student Affairs at the University of Wisconsin–Madison, led by the vice chancellor for student affairs. Our staff is dedicated to serving students and to helping them succeed in and out of the classroom in areas including health and well-being, student success and belonging, leadership and engagement, and student advocacy. This position reports to the Assistant Director for Belonging Programs.

Compensation:

The expected starting salary range for this position is $50,000 up to $55,000, depending on qualifications and experience. This position offers a comprehensive benefits package, including generous paid time off, competitively priced health/dental/vision/life insurance, tax-advantaged savings accounts, and participation in the nationally recognized Wisconsin Retirement System (WRS) pension fund. For a summary of benefits, please see https://www.wisconsin.edu/ohrwd/benefits/download/fasl.pdf

Required Qualifications:

Demonstrated experience working effectively with Native nations, tribal governments, or Indigenous communities.
Deep understanding of tribal sovereignty, cultural protocols, and the history of the Native nations in Wisconsin.
Demonstrated ability to connect with, support, and create engagement opportunities for college students from a wide variety of perspectives, beliefs, experiences, and identities.
Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities with attention to detail.
Demonstrated ability to work independently and solve problems creatively, while collaborating effectively with varied stakeholders.

new_jobs.description:
About Atlas

Atlas is a trusted leader in environmental and infrastructure consulting services; we provide services that enable communities to flourish and thrive. With a team of 3,500 employees and offices throughout the US, we combine local expertise and a network of relationships to deliver solutions to both public and private clients. Our services help improve the quality of life in the communities where we live and work. We always aim for smart, safe, and sustainable results. At Atlas we understand that our future is everyone’s responsibility, and we create a better experience at every stage of a project.

Job Description

As a Survey Technician - CADD Tech
, you will help deliver accurate survey and mapping work that supports field operations and keeps infrastructure projects moving safely and efficiently. In this role, you’ll partner with field crews, project managers, and project surveyors to prepare mapping deliverables, perform calculations, review plans, and support quality work from office to field. This is a full-time, non-exempt position based in Redmond, Washington.

Join a dynamic, value-driven, client- and community-focused environment where your work creates a lasting positive impact for the people and communities we serve.

Core Responsibilities

Create and update survey and mapping deliverables, including record maps, ALTA maps, parcel maps, and topographic surveys.
Prepare project materials for field crews, including record research, field crew prep, and data support.
Perform survey design work and calculations in AutoCAD/Civil 3D to support mapping and construction-related survey projects.
Partner closely with project managers and project surveyors to support boundary analysis, retracement work, and project execution.
Review project design plans for consistency, prepare RFIs, and maintain organized logs of changes, questions, and responses.
Support quality control by reducing field notes, downloading data collectors, checking survey data, and preparing technical calculations and reports for project needs.

You’ll thrive here if you have

At least 3 years of experience using AutoCAD/Civil 3D.
A solid understanding of surveying principles, control networks, and engineering plan reading.
Strong math, critical thinking, and written/verbal communication skills
Proficiency with everyday business tools, including Word and Excel.
A valid driver’s license and the ability to meet hiring requirements, including background screening and drug testing.
Bonus points for experience with MicroStation (InRoads/OpenRoads), StarNet, Leica office software, laser scanning/point clouds, LiDAR, or field survey equipment such as total stations, GPS, and levels. LSIT or EIT certification is also a plus.
The ability to travel up to 25% as project needs require.

What You Can Expect From Us

The A-Team Experience is our employee program focused on helping our people thrive professionally, personally and as part of a community. We trust our people to do great work and live fulfilling lives, and we provide resources that care for our people, both at work and in life:

Health & Wellness: We offer medical, dental and vision coverage with multiple plan options, including no-cost employee-only medical coverage.
Time Off & Family Support: We offer vacation time, paid holidays, sick & safety leave (SSL) and paid parental leave
Retirement: We help employees plan for the future with a 401(k) and company match.
Insurance: To provide protection and peace of mind, we offer Life, AD&D (Accidental Death & Dismemberment) and Disability insurance.
Safety Program: We are committed to safety as part of our ‘quality of life’ core value, and we provide approved PPE at no cost and reimbursement for prescription safety glasses and protective footwear.
Learning & Development: We provide clear career paths, learning resources and development programs allowing you to see how you can grow and advance within the company. We offer internal certifications on specific skills and support external credentials through tuition reimbursement.
Belonging: We support Employee Communities (ECs), voluntary, employee-led groups that create connections, belonging and shared purposes.
Flexibility: May vary by project demands and regional workloads, but we are committed to providing reasonable accommodation to help employees manage their personal and professional responsibilities.

Our people and our culture are central to our work. Our values bring us together, create a sense of belonging and give us purpose. They guide how we make decisions, how we work as a team and how we serve our clients.

Life: We enhance the quality of life. We value people and safety above all else.
Heart: As our hallmark, we act with compassion, empathy, and respect.
Trust: We work together as partners, doing what we say with full accountability.
Mastery: Always striving for the highest quality, greatness inspires our work.

new_jobs.title: Enterprise Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Husch Blackwell LLP
is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst
position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst
is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight

Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency

Dashboarding & Reporting

Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics

Data Management & Quality

Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities

Continuous Improvement & Growth

Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence

Position Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role (the role may be filled at more than one level; strong candidates earlier in their careers will also be considered)
Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations

new_jobs.title: Lead GIS Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

This Opportunity

Provides high level technical assistance and guidance for capturing, modeling, and analyzing geographical and tabular data to illustrate and determine spatial relationships as it pertains to client projects. Provides support and guidance for multi-site/phase projects by overseeing field investigations, spatial mapping, discovering patterns and trends, and developing mapping applications and tools at the intersection of data analysis, programming, and cartography. Ensures that documentation, mapping, and recommendations accurately portray the results of analyses and addresses impact and long-term risks on project areas by applying and integrating GIS data and perspective to environmental challenges across a variety of science and planning disciplines. Assists project leadership with overseeing environmental impact assessment, master planning, corrective/mitigation strategy development, permitting, and/or restoration activities. Ensures that responsibilities are delivered and adhered to with a level of quality that meets or exceeds acceptable industry standards.

Your Impact

Lead, conduct, and review GIS surveys and reports from teams and field sites for project research and investigation.
Oversee quality control standards and procedures for accurate and precise measurements, documentation, and analysis of incoming and existent data.
Coordinate the modeling and preparation of topographic maps, graphs, and tabular data using aerial photographs, GPS, and other tools and data to determine exact locations of project areas, site impact, and associated physical and geographic sensitivities.
Perform professional GIS work and oversee investigations, inspections, studies, and surveys to gain further information relating to digital mapping, merging topographical data with external data, verifying site conditions and characteristics, and validating and signing off on the authenticity of spatial data.
Analyze literature, maps, data, archived records, and other sources of information to identify, visualize, and articulate primary, secondary, and tertiary impact.
Prepare and complete GIS segments pertaining to impact assessment and/or permitting activities for assigned projects (e.g. CEQA, NEPA, etc.).
Prepare data and visualizations such as maps, tables, charts, reports, models, cross-sections, and other illustrations for the interpretation or presentation of more complex data, findings, or analyses.
Prepare comprehensive technical reports and presentations that explain research, findings, and recommendations to address, prevent, control, or remediate physical and geographic site issues on moderate to large-scale projects.
Ensure compliance with guidelines and project-specific procedures which include but are not limited to, the maintenance of any data collection, database, documentation, logbooks, and the management of a digital library of geographic maps in various file types.
Provide and oversee GIS input to planners, scientists, and engineers in the analysis, evaluation, and interpretation of spatial and geographic data obtained during field investigations, offering insight with moderate to high-level or complex threat mitigation, master planning, and permitting activities.
Assist with development and scoping of medium-to large-sized projects.
Oversee and monitor cross-functional teams in executing project work, including project budgets, tracking hours and expenses, and task completion.
Oversee existing Geographic Information Systems (GIS) databases and proficiency with geodatabase design.
Coordinate with regulatory agencies, clients, communities, subcontractors, and technical staff in a confident and professional manner.
Collaborate with professionals from a variety of disciplines to provide future ready solutions for clients.
Actively engage in business development and proposal writing.
Remain current in latest GIS practices, methods, procedures, subject matter, and techniques.
Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in GIS, Environmental Science, Planning, or a related field.
7 to 10 years of relevant post-education experience in discipline with prior GIS experience.
Advanced proficiency with ESRI’s Arc GIS platform.
Competent understanding of AutoCAD, Python, Visual Basic, Arcade, or SQL programming.
Strong analytical skills and prior demonstrated experience with research techniques, modeling data, scanning and digitizing files, and experience maintaining records and databases for assigned projects required.
Experience supporting project managers and serving as deputy project manager.
Demonstrated experience leading and reviewing technical reports, mapping efforts, impact evaluations, siting reports, planning scopes, and environmental permit applications for assigned GIS segments/project work.
Strong expertise with digitalized mapping, fieldwork (survey), data analysis, spatial relationship identification and evaluation.
Established experience coordinating with clients, regulatory permitting and resource agencies, communities, and technical staff required.
Highly capable self-leadership and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to effectively, persuasively, and tactfully interact with employees at all levels of the organization.
Ability to work independently and provide guidance and leadership to junior team or project members, with strict adherence to QA/QC.
Proficiency with technical writing, office automation and communication software, technology, web mapping applications and tools.
Well-developed critical thinking and problem-solving skills required to reach conclusions from research, testing results, data collation, and identifying the most effective solutions to accomplish objectives of assigned projects.
Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.
Ability to work schedules conducive to project-specific requirements that may extend beyond the typical workweek.
Occasional travel may be required depending on project-specific requirements.

Preferred Qualifications:

Master’s Degree is preferred.
Essential professional licensure/certification.

Experience with basic Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Access, Word, PowerPoint) and ability to write and to convey complex thoughts and ideas in a clear, concise manner.
GIS data management with demonstrated experience using ArcGIS Pro and PowerBI.

Husch Blackwell LLP
is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst
position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst
is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight

Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency

Dashboarding & Reporting

Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics

Data Management & Quality

Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities

Continuous Improvement & Growth

Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm

Job Description

AECOM is looking for a Mid-Level Environmental Scientist to grow their career – where we’ll empower you to learn in the delivery of environmental site characterization and remediation projects for the federal government.

Based in Arlington, VA, you’ll learn from other experienced staff who are ready to mentor you, and you’ll pass your knowledge on to others. You’ll gain valuable experience in the field and office. Field work will include soil and groundwater sampling, drilling, and the office work includes evaluating and reviewing data, writing reports and preparing project documents, and coordinating logistics for field activities.
Performs standard scientific work requiring application of techniques and procedures.
Detects problems when using standardized procedures because of the condition of sample, difficulties with the equipment, etc.
Conducts specific phases of projects for more experienced scientists.
Proposes appropriate analytical methods and techniques. Assists in providing advice and consulting services within scope of scientific knowledge.
Draws conclusions and makes recommendations based on analysis.
Interprets and records data, conducts analyses, compares findings to relevant studies and local, state and federal regulations to ensure compliance.
Works under general supervision

The ideal candidate must be able to work effectively both as an individual and within a collaborative team-environment. They must be able to demonstrate effective and timely communication skills especially during field work. The flexibility to work on a multitude of diverse projects, a positive attitude, and commitment to workplace health and safety are imperative. For the right candidate, this position holds significant potential to learn leadership and management skills that offer growth opportunities within AECOM.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science
2+ years of post-graduation relevant experience in environmental consulting (i.e., Remedial Investigations and Site Assessments) for Federal, State, or private clients. e or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
Valid U.S. driver’s license required. Subject to a motor vehicle records check.
Successful candidate will have to pass a background check.
Due to the nature of the work, U.S. citizenship is required. Sponsorship will not be available at this time or in the future.

Preferred Qualifications

Has general experience of geologic and environmental concepts (e.g., stratigraphy, geological processes, hydrogeology, hydrology, etc.).
Ability and desire to travel periodically for weeks- to months-long project assignments.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to document.
Safety-minded individual with the desire to implement safe working practices and be an active participant in safety kick-off calls and daily “tailgate” safety briefings.
Experience with basic Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Access, Word, PowerPoint) and ability to write and to convey complex thoughts and ideas in a clear, concise manner.
GIS data management with demonstrated experience using ArcGIS Pro and PowerBI.
Demonstrated experience visualizing project objectives developing project figures and tables.
Demonstrated experience utilizing statistics for figure development and data management.
OSHA 40-Hour HAZWOPER Certification
Ability to lift and carry 50 pounds and safely drive a full-size pickup truck.
Tolerance for work in outdoor environments in a range of weather conditions.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. new_jobs.title: Chemist - Environmental Scientist (part time)
new_jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Tetra Tech is adding a Part Time Environmental Scientist Chemist to our team based in Pittsburgh.

Why Tetra Tech

At Tetra Tech, we are Leading with Science to solve the world’s most complex challenges. Our industry-leading experts in engineering and consulting are committed to driving positive change in communities around the world. For over 50 years, we have been at the forefront of innovation and sustainability. Today we stand as a market leader, offering cutting-edge solutions in water, environment, energy, and international development. Our work has improved more than 625 million lives around the world.

Responsibilities

This is a part time (flexible hours) entry level position. Primary duty will be to act as data validation chemist, specializing in organic and/or inorganic analytical chemistry theory and methods, for CERCLA/RCRA type of environmental investigations. This position is in-office and local candidates will be given priority. US citizenship is required for this position due to the clients we serve.

This specialist will prepare validation reports, review analytical laboratory data packages, and apply data qualifications in an analytical database. Assist the validation manager and project managers on all aspects of environmental chemistry needed to support an environmental investigation (including data validation, analytical database tracking and support, data interpretation, laboratory and field analytical methods evaluation and selection, preparation of quality assurance project plans [data quality objectives], and data quality assessment). Responsibilities include data validation/data evaluation per EPA National Functional Guidelines and other EPA regional, state and client-specific data validation protocol.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Act as project chemist for environmental investigations (i.e., assist/advise project managers on all aspects of environmental chemistry needed to support environmental studies).
Advise project managers and other technical experts regarding chemistry theory and methods.
Perform data validation/data evaluation per EPA National Functional Guidelines, Department of Defense (DoD) modules, and other EPA regional, state and client-specific data validation protocol.
Prepare quality assurance project plans and data quality assessment reports, and assist in the identification of project data quality objectives.
Assist the Data Validation Group Manager in tracking/managing data validation deliverables.
Input analytical and field data and qualifiers, format database files received on diskette, print out data summary files. Assist with the organization of incoming data and electronic files.
Assist in the organization, management, and manipulation of project specific databases for purposes of conducting statistical analysis, conducting risk and nature and extent of contamination evaluations, and other types of evaluation.
Assist in the preparation and QA of chemicals of potential concern selection tables under the direction of risk assessment personnel. Assist in the update and maintenance of toxicity criteria and ARARs databases.
Assist in the preparation/QA of nature and extent of contamination tables/text and risk assessment spreadsheet deliverables/text under the direction of risk assessment and other technical personnel.
The position requires an individual to work well both independently and as part of a team and be detail oriented.
Conduct activities in line with internal procedures, legislation, and industry standards.
Pursue continuous professional development and maintain a high degree of discipline, knowledge and awareness.
Work in a safe manner at all times and report all health and safety incidents and concerns.
Additional duties as required.

Your Impact

Join Tetra Tech to make a real difference. Our work leverages cutting-edge technologies, advanced analytics, and the expertise of world-class scientists and engineers to create meaningful change around the world. Discover your full potential – join us to advance your career while leaving a lasting legacy.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

EDUCATION And/or EXPERIENCE

Bachelor’s degree (BA or BS) from four-year college or university in Chemistry (or related science) required.
One year experience in an analytical laboratory (commercial or research) performing inorganic/organic analyses highly preferred.
Familiarity with computer systems and databases required (i.e., experienced in Windows applications [e.g., Word, Excel, Access]).
Knowledge of EPA Functional guidelines for data validation a plus. Knowledge of EPA guidelines for preparation of quality assurance project plans, for identification of project data quality objectives, and for data quality assessment a plus.
Basic comprehension of EPA RI/FS and RFI/CMS processes a plus.

This position requires the candidate to be a U.S. Citizen due to the projects they will be working on.

LANGUAGE AND COMMUNICATION SKILLS:
Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of organization. Ability to translate chemistry principles and language to convey an understanding of same to other technical and non-technical personnel.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS:
Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as stoichiometry, solubilities, equilibrium constants, standard deviations, electrode potentials, proportions, percentages, area, circumference, and volume. Ability to apply concepts of basic algebra, geometry, and chemistry.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Indicate any special physical requirements and lifting requirements. Physical demands are consistent with an office environment setting and are limited to moving paper, reports, and lifting boxes and items under 25 pounds occasionally.

REASONING ABILITY:
Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form. Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations. Ability to apply chemical principles to derive practical solutions to environmental problems.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The work environment is consistent with an office setting. Travel on occasion is possible and the destination setting would also be an office environment.

OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES:
Strong organizational and administrative skills a must. Ability to work under pressure and within tight schedules. Ability to coordinate prioritization of work.

Life At Tetra Tech

The perks of working at Tetra Tech include:

Comprehensive and market-competitive benefits.
Merit-based financial rewards.
Flexibility and company-wide commitment to work/life balance.
Collaborative team atmosphere that values the contributions of all employees.
Learning and development opportunities for ongoing professional growth.

About Tetra Tech

Tetra Tech is the leader in water, environment, and sustainable infrastructure, providing high-end consulting and engineering services for projects worldwide. With 30,000 employees working together, Tetra Tech provides clear solutions to complex problems by Leading with Science® to address the entire water cycle, protect and restore the environment, design sustainable and resilient infrastructure, and support the clean energy transition.

Tetra Tech is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, sex, marital or familial status, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law. Tetra Tech is a VEVRAA federal contractor and we request priority referral of veterans.

We invite applications from all interested parties.

Explore our open positions at https://www.tetratech.com/careers. Follow us on social media to learn more about our people, culture, and opportunities:

LinkedIn: @TetraTechCareers

Twitter: @TetraTechJobs

Facebook: @TetraTechCareers

We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

Please no phone calls or agencies.

The Enterprise Data Analyst

Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities

Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information

Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics

new_jobs.title: Associate Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Brio Real Estate is a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company focused on real estate credit. Brio supports Blackstone’s Real Estate Debt Strategies (“BREDS”) investments across the globe. The company provides support across key functions, including corporate, transaction, and management services. The critical infrastructure and capabilities Brio provides for BREDS allows for effective support in the management of its global portfolio.

Today, BREDS has more than $76 billion of investor capital across high yield / opportunistic real estate credit funds, a publicly traded Mortgage REIT, and liquid securities strategies. BREDS is part of Blackstone Real Estate, the largest owner of commercial real estate globally, owning and operating assets across every major geography and sector.

Role Purpose

At Brio, the Associate, Data Analyst plays a key role in supporting our data ecosystem by connecting technical and business teams and enabling critical day-to-day operations. You will partner with cross-functional stakeholders, including the trading desk, to understand data needs, build queries, and deliver actionable insights. Using platforms like Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, and SQL Server, you will help develop scalable data solutions and support the integration of new datasets into our analytical framework.

What You Will Do

Play a central role in our data ecosystem. You'll serve as the critical link connecting technical and business functions, supporting essential workflows that power our daily operations. You'll be instrumental in onboarding and integrating every new dataset that enters our analytical framework.
Work directly with cross-functional teams. You'll collaborate with trading desk to understand their data needs and build queries to support their analysis
Work with industry-standard technology. You'll leverage platforms like Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, and SQL Server to build scalable data solutions

What You Should Have

An experienced data analyst with technical depth. You have 3+ years of professional experience analyzing complex datasets and writing SQL, Python, or similar languages to automate reporting and analysis. You are able to translate business requirements into efficient data solutions while accounting for performance and scalability.
Passionate about loan-level data and/or structured products. You have 2+ years of professional experience in fintech or structured products, working with loan-level information and understanding the complexities of amortization, prepayment, default, and loss severity. Your typical day-to-day involves wrangling messy loan tape data into a usable state, building complex analytics on asset performance, and creating reports on portfolio metrics. You're comfortable evaluating credit performance and communicating insights to both technical and business audiences.
Excited about modern data platforms. You work frequently with cloud data warehouses like Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, and SQL Server, and have experience optimizing queries and data models for performance at scale.
A first-rate collaborator and communicator. You're comfortable working alongside engineers and business teams, translating analytical requirements into actionable deliverables. You thrive on understanding client needs and delivering insights that drive decision-making.

On the Heels of Achieving 3X Growth, Virginia Transformer is Hiring to Do It Again!

We’re strategically building our team for the next 3X growth cycle—a phase that is both intense and incredibly rewarding. We’re highly selective about who joins us because this journey isn’t for everyone.
If you have the drive, grit, and expertise to perform at a high level—and you want to grow your career 3X alongside the Company’s growth—we’d love to talk.

Who We Are

Virginia Transformer is the largest U.S.-owned manufacturer of power transformers in North America. With more than 6,000 employees
, six manufacturing facilities (with another currently under construction), and a reputation for engineering excellence, we continue to lead the industry by delivering premium-quality transformers with the shortest lead times.
As a privately held company experiencing rapid organic growth, we move fast, make decisions quickly, and empower our people to take ownership.

Position Summary

Virginia Transformer is seeking a highly organized and proactive Project Coordinator
to join our Roanoke, VA office. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys driving projects forward, collaborating across multiple manufacturing facilities, and ensuring critical customer orders stay on schedule.
The Project Coordinator serves as the communication hub between customers, manufacturing plants, engineering, supply chain, and operations. Success in this role requires someone who naturally takes ownership, follows through on commitments, solves problems proactively, and keeps multiple priorities moving without constant direction.
An engineering degree is not required
. Candidates with strong project coordination, manufacturing, operations, customer service, or supply chain experience are encouraged to apply. A technical or engineering background is considered a plus.

Key Responsibilities

Coordinate customer projects from order release through final delivery.
Act as the primary liaison between the Dallas office and Virginia Transformer manufacturing facilities.
Monitor project schedules, milestones, and production status to ensure on-time execution.
Take ownership of assigned projects and proactively drive them to completion.
Collaborate with manufacturing, engineering, planning, purchasing, logistics, and customer service teams.
Identify potential schedule or production issues and work cross-functionally to resolve them.
Communicate project updates internally and externally with professionalism and urgency.
Maintain accurate project documentation, reports, and status updates.
Track critical action items and ensure accountability across multiple stakeholders.
Support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance project execution and customer satisfaction.

Qualifications

Required
Bachelor's degree preferred, but equivalent experience will be considered.
3+ years of experience in project coordination, operations, manufacturing, customer service, supply chain, or a related field.
Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.

Preferred
Engineering degree or technical background.
Experience working in manufacturing or industrial environments.
Experience coordinating projects across multiple facilities.

Experience supporting capital equipment or engineered-to-order products.

What We're Looking For

Takes ownership rather than waiting for direction.
Follows through until problems are solved.
Builds strong relationships across departments.
Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Keeps customers at the center of every decision.

Job Title

Project Coordinator III

Agency

Texas A&M University Health Science Center

Department

Center for Community Health & Aging

Proposed Minimum Salary

Commensurate

Job Location

College Station, Texas

Job Type

Staff

Job Description

Our Commitment

Texas A&M University is committed to enriching the learning and working environment by promoting a culture that respects all perspectives, talents & lived experiences. Embracing varying opinions and perspectives strengthens our core values which are: Respect, Excellence, Leadership, Loyalty, Integrity, and Selfless Service.   

Who We Are

As one of the fastest-growing academic health centers in the nation, Texas A&M Health encompasses five colleges and numerous centers and institutes working together to improve health through transformative education, innovative research and team-based health care delivery.

What We Want

The Project Coordinator III
supports the day-to-day operations of the Special Events, Services, and Resources core within the Texas Opioid Prevention for Students (TOPS) initiative. TOPS is a statewide, multitiered system of support (MTSS) funded by the Opioid Abatement Fund Council to prevent opioid misuse and overdose among K–12 students across Texas. Under general supervision of the Project Director, the Project Coordinator III supports the Project Manager III and the TOPS project team by coordinating and assisting with the completion of core project activities, including community implementation and outreach events, behavioral health service linkage and referral navigation support, and connecting students and families to opioid prevention resources and overdose education. This position benefits from familiarity with behavioral health systems and referral pathways but does not require clinical licensure.

What You Need To Know

Salary:
Will be commensurate based on the selected hire’s education and experience.

Please note:
This position is grant funded; future employment may be contingent upon future funding.

Apply! 
Submitting a cover letter, CV/Resume to assist us with the review process. You may upload these documents on the application under CV/Resume.  

Responsibilities

Project Coordination and Management

Coordinates core project activities supporting special events, community outreach, and resource linkage initiatives, including presentations, awareness campaigns, and community implementation events and initiatives.
Assists in developing and assessing work plans, schedules, and project controls to ensure core activities align with grant deliverables, timelines, and organizational objectives.
Prepares forecasting and progress reports against milestones, budgetary updates, and the change management process for core activities.
Monitors and prepares reports on financial activity and resource utilization for the assigned core project budget.
Coordinates with the Project Manager III, TOPS project team, and partner organizations to ensure cross-project dependencies and impacts are identified and managed.

Resource and Referral Service Support

Assists in coordinating behavioral health service connections, including scheduling and logistics for warm handoffs, telehealth navigation, and referral pathway documentation for students and families.
Supports student and family access to opioid prevention resources and overdose education programming by helping connect individuals to appropriate community based services; coordinates with vendors, community partners, and healthcare providers in the delivery and support of resources and services for core activities.

Who We Are

The Office of Academic Multicultural Initiatives (OAMI) supports and celebrates students' unique experiences, backgrounds, communities, and identities. Through a variety of programs, events, and campus-wide collaborations, we provide holistic support to help students achieve their academic ambitions while developing the skills and perspectives necessary for success in college and beyond. These initiatives support U-M's ongoing commitment to nurturing an intellectually and culturally diverse campus. This is accomplished through direct student service delivery that incorporates success coaching, peer mentorship, individual and student organization advising, student leadership development, and grant funding for student organizations and initiatives to promote academic and multicultural programming.

OAMI also leads key university-wide multicultural programs, including the Annual Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. Symposium, the Native American Student Association Powwow, gateway services for first-generation and DACA/undocumented students, and the coordination of eight annual cultural graduation celebration ceremonies.

Job Summary

The SuccessConnects Program Coordinator serves as a key contributor to OAMI's SuccessConnect program by providing holistic, strengths-based support that promotes undergraduate student success, retention, and engagement. The position combines direct student success coaching with the coordination of academic support initiatives that help students successfully navigate the transition to the university and achieve their academic, personal, and professional goals.

Through individualized and group success coaching, the Program Coordinator empowers students to develop effective strategies for academic achievement, personal growth, leadership development, and career exploration while connecting them with university resources and opportunities that enhance their educational experience.

The position also coordinates the day-to-day implementation of the SuccessConnect tutoring initiative by providing coordination of the delivery of individualized academic support and a team of student tutors, monitoring the program component's operations to enhance the delivery of academic support services.

Student Success Coaching - 65%

Provide holistic coaching services to enrolled students in SuccessConnects program; provide assistance to students to ensure their academic, personal and professional success
Meet one-on-one as well as in group settings with students to provide advice and counsel on curriculum-specific themes
Analyze, compare, and evaluate various courses of action for students within the scope of responsibilities and refer students to appropriate university resources as needed
Accept and act on referrals to support student needs and conduct follow-up on the utilization of resources
Follow program evaluation protocols to assess the effectiveness and impact of services on students and the university community.
Assist in the development of curricular content and participate in workshop presentations that support the growth and achievement of participants and address interests, challenges, knowledge, and experiences related to the overall success
Coordinate opportunities to build community and a supportive network of scholars
Identify and coordinate resources, experiential learning opportunities, and resource connections to enhance student awareness and preparation for collegiate and post-baccalaureate opportunities.
Maintain student participation and engagement documentation and data files
Manage, communicate, track, and analyze elements related to student progress, involvement, and participation via CRM tools

Tutoring Initiative Coordination - 35%

Coordinate the day-to-day implementation and operation of the SuccessConnect tutoring initiative to ensure the effective delivery of individualized academic support services that complement the program's holistic student success model.
Coordinate processes related to the recruitment, hiring, onboarding, training, scheduling, and ongoing support of undergraduate student tutors.
Provide guidance and accountability for a team of student tutors, fostering professionalism, inclusive practices, effective tutoring practices, and adherence to program expectations.
Oversee tutor assignments, student matching, tutoring schedules, communications, attendance tracking, and related operational processes to support efficient delivery of tutoring services.
Review tutor timekeeping records and process payroll approvals in accordance with university procedures.
Collaborate with evaluation staff to collect, analyze, and report tutoring participation and outcome data that inform program planning and effectiveness.
Support the coordinate of participation in campus-wide tutor resource platform, and student outreach and communication efforts that promote awareness and utilization of tutoring services among students, staff, and campus partners.
Serve as the primary point of contact for tutors by providing guidance, troubleshooting operational concerns, and connecting tutors and students with appropriate campus resources when needed.

Bachelor's degree and at least two years of experience in college student service.
Knowledge of the University of Michigan student academic and social culture.

new_jobs.description:
Job Title

Program Coordinator I - Recruiting & Admissions

Agency

Texas A&M University Health Science Center

Department

Rural Medicine

Proposed Minimum Salary

Commensurate

Job Location

Bryan, Texas

Job Type

Staff

Job Description

Our Commitment

Texas A&M University is committed to enriching the learning and working environment by promoting a culture that respects all perspectives, talents & lived experiences. Embracing varying opinions and perspectives strengthens our core values which are: Respect, Excellence, Leadership, Loyalty, Integrity, and Selfless Service.   

Who We Are

As one of the fastest-growing academic health centers in the nation, Texas A&M Health encompasses five colleges and numerous centers and institutes working together to improve health through transformative education, innovative research and team-based health care delivery.

What We Want

The Program Coordinator I, Recruiting & Admissions,
supports recruitment initiatives for the Texas A&M Naresh K. Vashisht College of Medicine. This role conducts outreach across Texas and guides prospective students through the admissions process. Responsibilities include coordinating communications, events, and maintaining recruitment data. The position also builds community partnerships to strengthen the applicant pipeline and support mission-driven recruitment.

What You Should Know

Salary:
$45,000-$52,000/annually and will be commensurate based on the selected hire’s education and experience.

Location/Schedule:
Bryan, TX/Full-Time;

This position may require up to 50% or more travel
Ability to travel across Texas, including occasional early mornings, evenings, and weekends

Please note:
This position is grant funded; future employment may be contingent upon future funding.

We encourage you to apply!
To help us learn more about your experience and interest in the role, please submit a cover letter and CV/resume. You can upload both documents in the CV/Resume section of the application.

Responsibilities

Recruiting and Outreach:

Primarily responsible for recruiting prospective medical school students from various Texas communities, serving as the face of the Texas A&M Naresh K. Vashisht College of Medicine in the field
Travel to high schools, community colleges, college fairs, health career events, and community gatherings across Texas to deliver presentations and host informational sessions
Direct prospective students to the correct contacts for their specific admissions, financial aid, and academic questions
Coordinate program communications including prospect messaging, admissions follow-ups, and university-wide outreach campaigns
Maintain databases of prospective students and conduct targeted outreach campaigns to drive-top-of funnel applicant traffic
Build and sustain relationships with school districts, community organizations, local healthcare providers, and other regional stakeholders

Event Planning and Execution:

Plan and execute recruiting events including information sessions, admitted student days, community health fairs, and networking events
Meet individually with prospective students and families to promote the program and assist in completing applications
Respond to inquiries regarding program offerings, prerequisites, and student financial aid options

Office and Administrative Support:

Provide administrative support for specialized recruiting activities and projects
Manage scheduling and confirmation of prospective student interviews and appointments
Maintain interview calendars for multiple administrators and office needs
May supervise, train, and evaluate student workers as needed
Perform other duties as assigned, including support for broader Naresh K. Vashisht College of Medicine recruitment efforts
Other duties as assigned

Required Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience
Two (2) years of related experience

Preferred Licenses And Certifications

A Class “C” vehicle operator’s license or ability to obtain within 30 days of employment

Preferred Qualifications

Two (2) years of related experience in recruiting, administration, or a closely related higher education role
Bachelor's degree
Experience in student recruiting, admissions, or event planning
Familiarity with rural Texas communities and their unique healthcare and educational challenges
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and the full Microsoft Office suite
Ability to develop and deliver presentations to small and large groups

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

This position requires significant travel to rural areas and across Texas including occasional early mornings, evenings, and weekends
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, including experience developing outreach and communication plans
Ability to work independently in the field and as part of a collaborative team
Strong emotional intelligence, conflict management, organization, and customer service orientation
Ability to manage multiple projects with varying deadlines and shift priorities as needed
Detail-oriented with strong interpersonal skills suited to multiple audiences
Self-directed problem-solver comfortable making independent decisions with minimal supervision
Ability to deliver instruction and effectively adapt content to meet the needs of individuals and groups

Why Texas A&M University?

We are a prestigious university with strong traditions, Core Values, and a community of caring and collaboration.  Amenities associated with a major university, such as sporting and cultural events, state-of-the-art recreation facilities, the Bush Library and Museum, and much more await you.  Experience all that a big city has to offer but with a reasonable cost-of-living and no long commutes.  

Medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, life and AD&D, flexible spending accounts, and long-term disability insurance with Texas A&M contributing to employee health and basic life premiums 
12-15 days of annual paid holidays  
Up to eight hours of paid sick leave and at least eight hours of paid vacation each month 
Automatic enrollment in the Teacher Retirement System of Texas  
Health and Wellness: Free exercise programs and release time 
Professional Development: All employees have access to free LinkedIn Learning training, webinars, and limited financial support to attend conferences, workshops, and more  
Educational release time and tuition assistance for completing a degree while a Texas A&M employee 
Living Well, a program at Texas A&M that has been built by employees, for employees 

Instructions to Applicants:
Applications received by Texas A&M University must either have all job application data entered, or a resume attached. Failure to provide all job application data or a complete resume could result in an invalid submission and a rejected application. We encourage all applicants to upload a resume or use a LinkedIn profile to prepopulate the online application.

All positions are security-sensitive. Applicants are subject to a criminal history investigation, and employment is contingent upon the institution’s verification of credentials and/or other information required by the institution’s procedures, including the completion of the criminal history check.

Equal Opportunity/Veterans/Disability Employer.
